costs.counter_scope: Explicit action counters omit internal anchor/autograd FFT operations; they cannot establish total operation savings. End-to-end timing includes execution. Native worker RSS is not per-method peak memory.
costs.offline_scope: Reference acquisition, design construction and local oracle fitting are not deployable speedup; reference and fit sums are subsets of study elapsed, not additive independent wall costs.

gates.capacity: Source-sampled development only; full-operator and fresh-parent confirmation remain pending

scope: Retained native R7 CPU development evidence; no new teachers/actions/fits and no scientific promotion.

sensitivity.global_row_order: Actual query_finished journal order; global withheld rows begin with validation, then training, then diagnostic sources.
sensitivity.local_objective_scope: Induced single-context ridge; independent local fits relax cross-context coupling and do not share the global joint objective.
sensitivity.projection_sensitivity_scope: Only recorded coefficient gains; no retained unregularized prediction maps/scenarios. Do not transfer positive-ridge robustness to projection.
sensitivity.selection_scope: Selected ridge/model held fixed. Sensitivity excludes model-selection discontinuity and changing-design/physics errors.
sensitivity.uncertainty_scope: Estimated per-source maximum uncertainties form an aggregate weighted calibration-label L2 ball; not certified teacher error, not per-source bounds.

timing.cold_scope: First benchmark invocation after accuracy acquisition; already warm process, not process-startup timing.
timing.scope: Four-source sequential bundle with a fresh original path/setup per source; no cross-source cache. One numerical thread, CPU, gradients enabled.
timing.uncertainty: Five paired randomized rounds per context only; no independent repetition/parent confidence claim, no frozen practical margin or utility threshold.
